notes.title: SIGame 8.5.1
notes.content:
Version 8.5.1 released!


 Large Workshop packages should work now
 Added button to edit player tables during the game

notes.title: SIGame 8.5
notes.content:
SIGame here! Version 8.5 released!


 Steam Workshop support: Subscribe to Workshop packages, select them inside the game and play!
 You can edit your name and sex in profile view
 Pause button key binding can be set up in settings
 Allow to select background image for game room
 Appellation message displayed on main screen (like Pause message)
 Lobby Trends have tabs for top packages and latest games
 Main menu styling: new background image and About game button
 Question for yourself title has been redesigned
 Edit table menu allowing to free or delete tables

notes.title: Future updates
notes.content:
Hi all!
According to your reviews, the following updates are planned.

 Replacing Cloudflare DNS with something else so it will not be periodically blocked
 Supporting Workshop
 Enhancing the UI
 Enhancing built-in question answers so the acceptance criteria would be more tolerant
 Embedding assets into the game so it will always load with all images and fonts
 Fix links opening

This updates are planned to be released within 1-2 next months.
